listen_address.description: IP address the SSH daemon listens on. Use * for all interfaces, or a specific IP.

port.description: Port number the SSH daemon listens on. Common alternatives: 2222, 22, 22222.

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility used for logging (e.g., AUTH, AUTHPRIV, DAEMON, USER).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: QUIET, FATAL, ERROR, INFO, VERBOSE, DEBUG, DEBUG1, DEBUG2, DEBUG3.

login_grace_time.description: Time (in seconds) the server waits for authentication before disconnecting.

strict_modes.description: Whether to check file permissions of user's files and home directory before accepting login.

max_auth_tries.description: Maximum number of authentication attempts per session.

max_sessions.description: Maximum number of open sessions per connection (global setting).

pubkey_authentication.description: Enable public key authentication (required for key-based login).

authorized_keys_file.description: Space-separated list of files from which public keys are read.

password_authentication.description: Enable password authentication (not recommended for security — use key auth instead).

permit_empty_passwords.description: Whether to allow login with empty passwords (strongly discouraged).

gssapi_authentication.description: Enable GSSAPI authentication (e.g., for Active Directory integration).

use_pam.description: Enable PAM authentication and account/session management (recommended).

accept_env.description: List of environment variables to accept from client (e.g., ['LANG', 'LC_*']).

set_env.description: List of environment variables to set unconditionally (e.g., ['TZ', 'PATH']).

sftp_subsystem_enabled.description: Whether to enable the SFTP subsystem.

sftp_internal.description: Use the built-in internal-sftp (recommended for chroot and SFTP isolation).

sftp_subsystem_path.description: Path to external SFTP server (used only if sftp_internal is false).

sftp_users.description: List of SFTP-specific user/group configurations (chrooted or restricted users).

name.description: Human-readable label for this SFTP configuration block.

match_user.description: SSH username to match for this block (mutually exclusive with match_group).

match_group.description: SSH group name to match for this block (mutually exclusive with match_user).

chroot_path.description: Chroot directory (e.g., /home/%u or /sftp/%U). Must be owned by root and not group-writable.

disable_tcp_forwarding.description: If true, disables TCP forwarding for this user (recommended for SFTP-only users).

disable_x11.description: If true, disables X11 forwarding for this user (recommended for SFTP-only users).

set_env.description: Environment variables to set for this user (overrides global).

allow_tcp_forwarding.description: Override for AllowTcpForwarding (yes/no) if not using disable_tcp_forwarding.

x11_forwarding.description: Override for X11Forwarding (yes/no) if not using disable_x11.

max_sessions.description: Max open sessions for this user.

max_auth_tries.description: Max authentication attempts for this user.

pubkey_auth_only.description: If true, enables pubkey auth only (forces PasswordAuthentication=no).

tcp_keep_alive.description: Send TCP keep-alive messages (helps detect dead connections).

client_alive_interval.description: Seconds between client alive messages (0 = disabled).

client_alive_count_max.description: Number of client alive messages without response before disconnecting.

max_startups.description: Rate-limit for unauthenticated connections (e.g., '10:30:100' = start dropping at 10, full drop at 100, 30% rate at 10).

max_sessions_global.description: Maximum open sessions per connection (global — overridden by per-user Match blocks).

banner_path.description: Path to login banner file (shown before auth). Use empty string ('') to disable.

print_last_log.description: Whether to print the last login time and hostname.

print_motd.description: Whether to print /etc/motd (if PAM doesn’t handle it).

x11_forwarding_global.description: Enable X11 forwarding globally (not recommended for security).

x11_display_offset.description: X11 display offset (to avoid conflicts with local X servers).

x11_use_localhost.description: Bind X11 forwarding to localhost only (recommended for security).

permit_user_environment.description: Allow users to set environment variables via ~/.ssh/environment (security-sensitive).
